pages.text: $(#6B4423)🍫 Snowfield Nectar · Velvet Curtain 🌸$()$(br2)$(l)$(#DAA520)「Let bitterness sprout wings, let sweetness shield against the winter’s bite」$()$(br)The delicate aroma of $(#B19CD9)dried lilies$() merges with the rich essence of $(#6B4423)molten cocoa$(), while $(#FFD700)rock honey$() and $(#B0B0B0)snow cream$() are whisked together using a $(#8B4513)oaken tea whisk$()—a miraculous beverage capable of $(l)creating a warm oasis within the blizzard$().

$(#6B4423)▌ Dual Protection $()$(br2)$(l)$(#87CEEB)🪶 Feathered Descent$()$(br)Falling feels as gentle as $(#B19CD9)lily petals$() drifting into a canyon.$(br2)$(l)$(#4169E1)❄ Honeyed Barrier$()$(br)A $(#B0B0B0)pearl-like insulating layer$() forms around the body, shielding against extreme cold.

$(br2)$(#8B4513)▌ Forge-Brewing Process $()$(br)- Melt $(#6B4423)cocoa powder$() and $(#DAA520)crystalized honey$() into a $(#804000)lava-like syrup$().$(br)- $(#B19CD9)Lily petals$() must be dried $(#4682B4)at low temperatures$() until they become $(#E6E6FA)semi-translucent$().$(br)- When adding $(#B0B0B0)cream$(), it must be whisked in a $(#00BFFF)spiral motion$().$(br2)$(#FFD700)※$() A perfect brew will display a $(#CD853F)tiger-stripe pattern$() along the cup’s walls.

$(br2)$(#6B4423)『 Polar Station Journal 』$()$(br)An entry from a snowfield outpost keeper:$(br)'Sipping this blend of $(#B19CD9)flower crowns$() and $(#6B4423)molten essence$(),$(br)I leaped into an $(#4169E1)ice crevasse$() and glided down like a $(#87CEEB)snowy owl$().$(br)Meanwhile, the $(#B0B0B0)cream$() wove a $(#DAA520)golden silk shield$() within my veins,$(br)turning the $(#696969)permafrost’s chill$() into nothing but a $(#FFD700)gentle embrace$().'
